caption: The drawing depicts a piece of furniture rendered primarily in red tones, consisting of a tall hutch or cabinet with two main sections. The upper section has two glass-fronted doors, each divided into six panes by a grid of narrow muntins forming diamond patterns. The bottom section is a solid rectangular base with paneled doors or surfaces. The top of the cabinet features an overhanging cornice with a decorative edge, while the base stands on four short, cabriole-style feet. The drawing includes a frontal view on the left side and a profile view on the right, both within a large rectangular border. Two smaller technical sketches, one showing a side elevation and the other a scaled front elevation with measurements, are located in the lower corners of the page. The background is beige, and the cabinet is uniformly colored in shades of red, with some areas showing variations in tone for shading and detail. The glass panes appear transparent or lightly shaded in gray. Lines and notations in the sketches are rendered in black ink.
title: Secretary
